# Hostile arguments for audit-logs and the three recipes it mirrors. test-audit-logs.sh
# runs every case with audit-logs, and a case that names profile, frames or deltas with
# that script too (the arguments after the subcommand), which must refuse it with the same
# exit status and the same line; test-dnr.sh runs the scripts' cases on their own. Both
# build the working directory with hostile_layout, the same block in both files. Each case
# must exit non-zero, change no file, leave no temporary file, and print no canary text.
#
# One case per line: a name, then each argument, all separated by tabs. In an argument:
#   @WT@       the working directory's absolute path
#   @OUT@      an absolute directory outside the working directory
#   @LONG:N@   N repetitions of "a"
#   @NL@       a newline        @ESC@  an escape character (0x1b)
#
# grammar
no arguments
unknown subcommand	scan	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
option before the subcommand	--out	incident_1/x.jsonl	profile	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
profile with no corpus	profile
profile with only --out	profile	--out	incident_1/x.txt
deltas with no mode	deltas	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
deltas with an unknown mode	deltas	balances	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out with no value	frames	--out
--out twice	frames	--out	incident_1/a.jsonl	--out	incident_1/b.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--instructions twice	frames	--instructions	--instructions	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--instructions on profile	profile	--instructions	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--instructions on deltas	deltas	tokens	--instructions	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--by with no value	deltas	tokens	--by
--by twice	deltas	tokens	--by	mint	--by	mint	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--by account on tokens	deltas	tokens	--by	account	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--by mint on lamports	deltas	lamports	--by	mint	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--by an unknown grouping	deltas	tokens	--by	owner	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--by=value form	deltas	tokens	--by=mint	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--by on frames	frames	--by	mint	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--by after a corpus	deltas	tokens	incident_1/corpus.jsonl	--by	mint
--out after a corpus	frames	incident_1/corpus.jsonl	--out	incident_1/x.jsonl
--out before the deltas mode	deltas	--out	incident_1/x.tsv	lamports	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out=value form	frames	--out=incident_1/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
an option-shaped --out value	frames	--out	--instructions	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
-h	frames	-h
a lone dash for stdin	frames	-
a double dash	deltas	lamports	--	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
# input paths
absolute input inside the working directory	frames	@WT@/incident_1/corpus.jsonl
absolute input outside it	frames	@OUT@/secret.jsonl
.. out of the run directory	frames	incident_1/../canary.jsonl
.. out of the working directory	frames	../outside/secret.jsonl
./.. out of the working directory	frames	./../outside/secret.jsonl
home directory	frames	~/secret.jsonl
a file outside every run directory	frames	canary.jsonl
an audit run directory	frames	audit_1/canary.jsonl
a file that is a link	frames	incident_1/link.jsonl
a file reached through a directory link	frames	incident_1/dlink/secret.jsonl
a run directory that is a link	frames	incident_2/secret.jsonl
a run directory with no .gitignore	frames	incident_3/canary.jsonl
a run directory whose .gitignore is not *	frames	incident_4/canary.jsonl
a run directory named in capitals	frames	INCIDENT_1/corpus.jsonl
a run directory number of seven digits	frames	incident_1234567/corpus.jsonl
a run directory itself	frames	incident_1
an empty component	frames	incident_1//corpus.jsonl
a . component	frames	incident_1/./corpus.jsonl
a trailing slash	frames	incident_1/corpus.jsonl/
a FIFO	frames	incident_1/fifo
a FIFO for profile	profile	incident_1/fifo
a directory	deltas	tokens	incident_1/subdir
a newline in the path	frames	incident_1/corpus.jsonl@NL@canary.jsonl
an escape in the path	frames	incident_1/@ESC@[31mcorpus.jsonl
a very long path	frames	incident_1/@LONG:5000@
a long path component	frames	incident_1/@LONG:300@.jsonl
a missing corpus	profile	incident_1/missing.jsonl
a missing corpus after a good one	frames	incident_1/corpus.jsonl	incident_1/missing.jsonl
a link after a good corpus	deltas	lamports	incident_1/corpus.jsonl	incident_1/link.jsonl
an input with a second name	frames	incident_1/twin.jsonl
the other name of that input	deltas	tokens	incident_1/twin-2.jsonl
a hard link to a file outside every run directory	profile	incident_1/hard.txt
a second ./	frames	././incident_1/corpus.jsonl
an input under a file	frames	incident_1/corpus.jsonl/x
a missing run directory	frames	incident_9/x.jsonl
a run directory holding no file	profile	incident_1/
--instructions after --out	frames	--out	incident_1/x.jsonl	--instructions	--instructions	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
# --out paths
--out absolute	frames	--out	@WT@/incident_1/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out outside the working directory	frames	--out	@OUT@/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out with ..	frames	--out	incident_1/../protected.txt	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out outside every run directory	frames	--out	protected.txt	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out that is a link	frames	--out	incident_1/out-link.txt	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out through a directory link	frames	--out	incident_1/dlink/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out into a linked run directory	frames	--out	incident_2/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out with a second name	frames	--out	incident_1/hard.txt	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out onto a directory	frames	--out	incident_1/subdir	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out under a file	frames	--out	incident_1/corpus.jsonl/x	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out in a missing directory	frames	--out	incident_1/no-such-dir/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out into a run directory with no .gitignore	frames	--out	incident_3/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out very long	frames	--out	incident_1/@LONG:5000@	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out home	deltas	tokens	--out	~/x.tsv	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out onto its own input	frames	--out	incident_1/corpus.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out onto its own input, spelled differently	deltas	lamports	--out	./incident_1/corpus.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out onto a collected corpus	frames	--out	incident_1/corpus/transactions.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out in a subdirectory	frames	--out	incident_1/subdir/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out onto the ledger	profile	--out	incident_1/LEDGER.md	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out onto the run directory's .gitignore	profile	--out	incident_1/.gitignore	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out hidden	frames	--out	incident_1/.x.txt	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out with another extension	deltas	tokens	--out	incident_1/x.json	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out with no name before the extension	frames	--out	incident_1/.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out into a missing run directory	frames	--out	incident_9/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out into an audit run directory	frames	--out	audit_1/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out into a run directory whose .gitignore is not *	deltas	tokens	--out	incident_4/x.tsv	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out after a refused input	frames	--out	incident_1/x.jsonl	incident_1/link.jsonl
--out with a . component	frames	--out	incident_1/./x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out empty	frames	--out		incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out naming the run directory	frames	--out	incident_1	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out naming the run directory with a slash	deltas	tokens	--out	incident_1/	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out with a newline in its name	frames	--out	incident_1/x@NL@y.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out into a run directory named in capitals	frames	--out	INCIDENT_1/x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out whose name starts with a dash	frames	--out	incident_1/-x.jsonl	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out with a name of 129 bytes	profile	--out	incident_1/@LONG:125@.txt	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
--out onto a FIFO	frames	--out	incident_1/fifo	incident_1/corpus.jsonl
